permissions.name: g2-microphone
permissions.desc: Capture speech from the G2 glasses mic only (never the phone mic) while you hold to talk; the audio is streamed to the kid-glasses relay for transcription and not stored on the phone.

permissions.name: network
permissions.desc: Talk to the kid-glasses relay (pairing, WebSocket for messages and speech) and the plugin's own Cloudflare Worker.
